ns2:course.label: French Active Review I
ns2:course.description: Reviews materials covered in FR 101 and FR 102 in preparation for entrance into FR 103 or FR 133. Open to students with high school French or by placement score or consent of department only. Not open to students with credit in FR 101 or FR 102. Prerequisite: One or two years of high school FR and placement score in 101 range.
